newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Share sale to boost Telstra performance -govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Share sale to boost Telstra performance -govt.

text.p: Australian Communications Minister Richard Alston said on Wednesday the performance of telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp would improve after its partial privatisation.
"We are confident that part privatising Telstra will improve its performance," Alston said in a speech given in Melbourne. A copy of the speech was available here.
He said Telstra accounted for just over two percent of Australia's GDP and it was one of Australia's largest tax payers.
"We believe that if this base is to be enhanced, partial privatisation is essential," he said.
In early December, the Australian government won parliamentary approval for the sale of one-third of Telstra.
The government plans to raise about A$8.0 billion through the sale, which is not expected to take place until the final quarter of calendar 1997.
